description: Run every configuration a SysML v1 tool's results sidecar indexes against the migrated model (the CompareResults RPC, the CLI's -compare-results with -action, -runs, -seed, -draws, -clock-step and -observe): each on its target, for its recorded run count under its duration mode, or the runs and draws given, and table the tool's and OpenSysML's min, mean, p50, p90 and max of each observable with their relative difference. `configurations` carry each one's status (holds, fails, unresolved), its rows, the distributions compared, the errors and notes, and the lines the CLI prints. The result is the CompareResultsResponse as protojson writes it.

actions.description: the configurations compared, by qualified or simple name (the CLI's -action); every indexed configuration when empty

clockStep.description: the clock step replacing every configuration's, in seconds; 0 is a continuous clock (the CLI's -clock-step)

draws.description: the draw policy replacing every configuration's durationSimulationMode: random, min, max or average (the CLI's -draws)

engine.description: the engine selection, as list_engines names them

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

observe.description: the stored observables compared, each with the feature of the run that answers it (the CLI's -observe)

feature.description: the feature of the run that answers it; empty for the target's feature of the observable's own name

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

results.description: the results sidecar as JSON, as sysml -migration-results writes it

runs.description: the runs made of every configuration when positive (the CLI's -runs); else each configuration's own numberOfRuns, or one

seed.description: the seed the runs derive theirs from (the CLI's -seed); without one, runs that draw at random are refused unless draws fixes them

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: compare_results
